title: Request for Proposal – Mobile Application Redesign
executive_summary: GlobalTech Services Consortium seeks qualified vendors to redesign its existing cross‑platform mobile application (iOS & Android) to improve user engagement, performance, accessibility, and brand consistency. The project will involve a complete UI/UX overhaul, migration to a modern technology stack, integration with back‑end APIs, and delivery of a maintainable codebase. Proposals are due by 2026‑10‑15. Selected vendor will commence work in early November 2026 with a target go‑live date of 2027‑04‑30.
project_objectives: Increase Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the mobile app from 32 to 55 within six months of launch
Reduce average app load time to under 2 seconds on 4G networks
Achieve WCAG 2.2 AA compliance for accessibility
Implement a modular architecture that supports future feature extensions without major re‑work
Standardize analytics and event tracking across both platforms
scope_of_work: Conduct stakeholder interviews and user research to validate redesign direction
Produce high‑fidelity wireframes, interactive prototypes, and design system assets
Develop native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) applications using a shared codebase where feasible (e.g., Kotlin Multiplatform or Flutter)
Migrate existing API integrations and implement new secure authentication (OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect)
Implement in‑app analytics (Firebase, Mixpanel) and push‑notification infrastructure
Perform comprehensive QA, performance testing, and accessibility testing
Provide documentation, source code repository access, and knowledge‑transfer workshops
Support post‑launch bug‑fixes and performance tuning for a 90‑day warranty period
functional_requirements: User Registration & Login with email, social (Google, Apple) and SSO options
Personalized Dashboard displaying key metrics and notifications
Push Notification preferences and in‑app messaging
Search & filter functionality for core data sets
Offline mode with data sync when connectivity is restored
Role‑based access control for admin, manager, and end‑user roles
technical_requirements: Target OS versions: iOS 15+ and Android 9 (API 28)+
Use Swift 5.8 for iOS and Kotlin 1.9 for Android
Adopt a shared UI layer via Flutter 3.13 or Kotlin Multiplatform as optional
Integrate with existing RESTful APIs (JSON, OAuth2) and support GraphQL where needed
Implement CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
Code must pass SonarQube quality gate (≥ 90 % coverage, no critical bugs)
Data encryption at rest and in transit (AES‑256, TLS 1.3)
Comply with GDPR and CCPA privacy requirements
design_requirements: Adopt GlobalTech brand palette, typography, and iconography
Create a responsive design system with component library for reuse
Ensure WCAG 2.2 AA compliance (contrast ratios, focus order, screen‑reader labels)
Provide motion design guidelines (duration ≤ 300 ms for transitions)
Deliver assets in SVG, PNG (2x/3x) and Sketch/Figma source files
Include dark‑mode version for both platforms
deliverables: Design system documentation and component library
High‑fidelity UI mockups for all screens (Figma)
Source code repository (Git) with branch strategy documentation
Build artifacts for iOS (TestFlight) and Android (Internal Play Store)
Knowledge‑transfer workshop deck and recorded session
Post‑launch warranty bug‑fix log and final acceptance report
project_timeline: 2027-04-10: User acceptance testing (UAT) with pilot group
2027-04-30: Production release to App Store & Google Play
submission_guidelines: All proposals must be submitted in PDF format via the secure portal (https://rfp.globaltech.org) no later than 23:59 UTC on 2026‑10‑15
Provide a cover letter signed by an authorized representative
Include company profile, relevant experience (minimum 3 similar mobile redesign projects), and CVs of key personnel
Detail the proposed methodology, project schedule, and resource allocation
Provide a cost breakdown (labour, licences, third‑party services, travel) and total fixed‑price offer
Attach references with contact information for at least two recent clients
Declare any conflicts of interest or existing relationships with GlobalTech
All monetary values must be in USD
vendor_evaluation_criteria: Understanding of project scope and objectives (15 %)
Proposed technical solution & compliance with requirements (25 %)
budget_requirements: Total fixed‑price budget not to exceed USD 350,000 inclusive of all taxes, licences, and travel
Payment schedule: 10 % upon contract signing, 30 % upon delivery of design assets, 40 % upon acceptance of beta release, 20 % after final sign‑off and warranty commencement
Any out‑of‑scope work will be billed on a time‑and‑materials basis (USD 150 / hour)
terms_and_conditions: All deliverables become the exclusive property of GlobalTech upon full payment
Vendor must maintain confidentiality of all proprietary information (NDA signed prior to award)
Compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and export controls is mandatory
Vendor shall carry professional liability insurance of at least USD 1 million
Intellectual property: vendor grants worldwide, perpetual, royalty‑free license for any pre‑existing components incorporated into the solution
Termination: either party may terminate with 30 days written notice; fees for completed milestones remain payable
Force majeure clause applies as per standard GlobalTech contract template
Dispute resolution shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York, USA
